content: Musey Tophphiyappe machcho ekkida gishshas Maaramanne Aarooney zigirsan iza hizgi kadhida,
«GODAY Muse baggara xalla haasaydee? Nu baggara haasaybeennee?» GODAY istti gidayssa ubbaaka siyides.
Musey gidikko biitta bolla diza asaa ubbaafe aadhdhida ashke asa.
Heerakka GODAY Muse, Aaroonenne Maaramo, «Intte heedzdzay Gaytoteththa dunkaanekko haa yiite!» gides; isttika bida.
Histtiin GODAY tuus misatiza shaara giddora wodhdhidi Dunkaaneza pengen eqqidi, «Haysso Aaroone! Hanne Maaramee!» gi xeygides; Nam7atikka gede iza sinth shiiqida.
GODAY isttas, «Hekko ha7i ta inttena gizayssa akeeki siyite!
GODAA hanqoy istta bolla tama mala eexxi kezides; izikka istta heen aggi bides.

Shaarazi dunkaaneza bollafe dendi biin Maarama inchchirachcha harganchcha gidadus; inchchirachcha hargezikka izi bolla shachcha mala booththides; Aarooney Maaramo beyishin iza izas inchchirachcha harganchcha gida beettadus.
Aarooney Muses, «Ta godoo! Nuni ne bolla ooththida nagaraa gaason hayssi iita qixaatey nu bolla polettana mala ooththofarkkii!
Izakka ba aayi ulon hayqqada izis bagga asateththay meetettichchiin yelettida awucaya naa mala ooththofarkkii!» gides.
Hessa gishshas Musey, «Xoossawu! Izo paththarkkii!» giidi pude GODAAKKO waassides.

GODAYKKA Muses, «Izi aaway ayfeson cuch cuttidaarakka yeellatada laappun gallas gakkanaas gam7a erekkee? Hessa gishshas iza asay diza heeraappe kezada laappun gallas gakkanaas asi bayndason takkaashshu; hessafe guye asay dizaso gelanaas dandayawus» gi zaarides.
Hessa gishshas Maarama asi diza gutappe kare kezada laappun gallas gakkanaas bana genththadus; iza heeppe simmana gakkanaas derezi ba dizasoppe haraso qaaxxibeenna.
Hessafe guye asay Haxirooteppe dendidi Paaraane bazzon dunkaani uttides.
